description_en: Updates the configuration of an RTC AI Agent instance, such as its voice and greeting
description_zh: 修改一个RTC互动AI智能体实例配置，如音色、欢迎语等
kebab_example: aliyun ice update-rtc-robot-instance --instance-id 727dc0e296014bb58670940a3da95592 --config Greeting=Hello EnableVoiceInterrupt=false VoiceId=zhixiaoxia --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateRtcRobotInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI Agent instance to update
parameters.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: Controls whether voice interrupt is enabled. This change takes effect immediately
fields.help_zh: 是否允许语音打断，立即生效
fields.name: enable_voice_interrupt

fields.help_en: The greeting message. The greeting is not updated if it has already been played
fields.help_zh: 欢迎语，若欢迎语已播报则修改无效
fields.name: greeting

fields.help_en: The ID of the voice. The new voice takes effect on the AI Agent's next utterance
fields.help_zh: 音色ID，修改后AI智能体下一句话生效
fields.name: voice_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration for the AI Agent instance
parameters.name: config
